goal: Pick up the key, pass it between hands, insert it into the keyhole (slot) and turn it so it ends fully inserted, upright and rotated.
instruction_templates: Pick up the key, hand it over to the other hand, insert it into the keyhole, then turn it.
success: key's bbox lowest point is more than 0.025 m below the top of slot's bbox: slot bbox z_max - key bbox z_min > 0.025 m (is_A_depth_in_B).
key origin and slot origin are within 0.007 m in the horizontal (world xy) plane (is_AB_xy_distance_within_threshold, threshold=0.007).
key's local z-axis is within 7 deg of world up (is_axis_up, axis [0,0,1], threshold=7).

key's local +x axis (in world) is within 30 deg of the direction R_slot * (0.5, -0.866, 0), i.e. the slot's local x-axis rotated by -60 deg about the slot's local z (is_axis_aligned label_A=key axis_A=[1,0,0] vs label_B=slot axis_B=[1/2,-sqrt(3)/2,0], align_threshold=30).
evaluation: All listed conditions are checked together, in order, after every action (reward_manager.step runs once per action, after the action's whole control sequence has executed; nothing is checked between actions). They form a single stage: all must be true at the same action boundary (any list inside the conditions means 'at least one of'). Success is declared at the first action boundary where all hold; the episode then ends. No final_check list is used. Otherwise the episode ends as a failure after step_lim actions. There is no requirement to release the key or to return the arms; no early-fail rule.
objects: key: a key (category key, idx 0), 1, start on table at x in [-0.2,-0.1] or [0.1,0.2] (either side), y in [-0.2,-0.1], random yaw up to +-30 deg
slot: the keyhole block (category key_slot, idx 0), static geometry, 1, x in [-0.2,-0.1] or [0.1,0.2], y in [-0.2,-0.15], yaw up to +-30 deg
notes: The 'hand it over' part of the instruction is not checked; only the final key pose relative to the slot matters. The turn requirement is the -60 deg (relative to the slot's local x) alignment within +-30 deg, i.e. a rotation of roughly 30-90 deg from the slot's x direction, measured in 3-D angle (no projection). The required key rotation about its vertical axis depends on the slot's yaw, so the target orientation is expressed relative to the slot, not the world. Threshold 0.007 m xy is tight (7 mm). Partial credit (get_score: lift key >0.05 m = 15, full = 100) is separate from success. Predicate conventions (from func_parser.py): object 'position' = the object's root/origin position in world coordinates (metres, z up); 'bbox' = the 8 corners of the object's local bounding box transformed to world; is_A_in_B = A's origin xy lies inside the convex hull of B's world-projected bbox AND A's origin z > B's bbox z_min; is_axis_up(label, axis, threshold) = angle between (object rotation applied to the local axis) and world +z is < threshold degrees (wrapper default threshold 15 deg); is_axis_aligned = angle between two (optionally functional-point-frame) axes < align_threshold degrees, optionally after projection onto a plane (project_plane='xy' drops z and renormalises); all_robot_back_to_origin() default = for every target (agent-controlled) arm, end-effector pose vs its pose at episode start: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m (per-axis, not Euclidean) and orientation difference <= 20 deg; is_all_gripper_open(open_threshold) = every target gripper's normalised opening ((val-scale0)/(scale1-scale0)) >= open_threshold (wrapper default 0.6).
